description: Calibration set for the relevance gate (Task 06). Deliberately different wording from the 20 evaluation test cases, so the threshold is not tuned on the test set. 'answerable' questions have answers in the knowledge base; 'gap' questions are about Pearlz but are not answered by any document; 'off_topic' questions have nothing to do with Pearlz.
